query: I am a Board Member/ Director. Am I considered a self-employed person, and do I have to contribute to my CPF?
reference_answer: It depends on the nature of your relationship with the company, and the nature of the moneys received.If you’re engaged as a Board Member or Director under a contract of employment (or Contract of Service) with the company, you’ll have to contribute to your CPF as an employee.If you’re engaged in a business, profession or vocation of providing services as a Board Member or Director to companies, you’ll have to contribute to your MediSave as a self-employed person (SEP).Please visit theInland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) websitefor the differences in treatment between employees and SEPs.
answer: As a Board Member/ Director, you are generally considered self-employed. However, whether you need to contribute to CPF depends on your employment status. If you are an independent contractor, yes, you must contribute to CPF. [Document 1]
